metadata.services: Triple Play Bundle: Fiber 500 + Digital TV + Voice ($110/mo)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi, yes, I'm calling about my most recent bill. It seems to have gone up and I'm not sure why.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that for you. I'll just need to verify your account first. May I have your full name, please?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Kimberly Taylor.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Taylor. And could I get the Customer ID number listed on your bill?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, it's... uh... CUST-1024.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. And for the final security step, could you please provide the 4-digit security PIN associated with your account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, my PIN is 3-5-6-5.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you for verifying that. One moment while I pull up your account details.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright Ms. Taylor, I have your account open here. I see you have our Triple Play Bundle with the Fiber 500 internet.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's right. And my bill is normally about $110, but the one I just got is for $125.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I'm seeing that charge on the latest invoice dated just a few days ago. I can see the total is indeed $125.00.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right. So why the $15 increase? Did the rates go up for everyone?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question. Let me dive into the statement details to see exactly what changed. This will just take me about 30 to 45 seconds to review the line items. Is that alright?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's fine. I'll wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Ms. Taylor. I've found the reason for the change.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, what is it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It appears that a 12-month promotional discount of $15 per month, which was applied when you first signed up, has just expired.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: A promotional discount? I don't remember that. I thought $110 was the fixed price for the bundle.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can understand the confusion. It's a common introductory offer for new customers. The standard, non-promotional rate for the Triple Play bundle you have is $125. The discount brought it down to $110 for your first year of service.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: My first year... I guess it has been about a year since I signed up. I just wish I had gotten a heads-up or something.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely agree that communication is key. Let me check the past few bills. Yes, it looks like there was a small note in the 'Promotions and Discounts' summary section of your last two bills mentioning the expiration date, but I know that part of the bill is easy to overlook.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yeah, I probably didn't even notice it. I just look at the total amount due. So, am I just stuck paying $125 now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're now at the standard rate for the plan, yes. However, we definitely value your business and I'd be happy to see if there are any current promotions or loyalty offers we can apply to your account to help lower that cost.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, really? Yes, please. I'd appreciate that. I'm on a pretty tight budget and an extra $15 a month wasn't something I was planning for.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. Let me check our retention department's offers for long-standing customers in good standing, which you are. This might take me a minute or two. Can you hold?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I'll hold. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ms. Taylor? Thank you so much for your patience.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'm here. Did you find anything?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I did. So, while I can't re-apply the original new-customer discount, I do have a 'Customer Loyalty' offer that I am authorized to apply to your account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay... and what does that do?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can apply a $10 monthly credit to your account for the next 12 months.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: A $10 credit... So my bill would be what, $115?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's exactly right. It would bring your monthly total from $125 down to $115, plus your usual taxes and fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So it's not quite back to the $110 I was paying, but it's better than nothing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand. This is the best available offer in our system for your account at this time. It would lock in that $115 price for another full year.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And there's no contract extension or anything tricky involved?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, not at all. It's simply a courtesy credit. Your services and terms remain exactly the same. The credit is just applied on top.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm. Okay. A hundred and fifteen dollars. For another year.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. And just like before, you can always call us back when that year is coming to an end to review new options.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, you know what, that sounds fair. Let's do it. I'll take the $10 credit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I'm happy we could find a solution for you. I'm going to apply that to your account right now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So, my next bill that comes... will it be for $115?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question, let me clarify. Because your current billing cycle has already started at the higher rate, your very next bill will be a little bit complex. It will show a pro-rated credit.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Pro-rated? What does that mean?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It means we'll credit you back the difference for the portion of the month that has passed. So your next bill will be slightly less than $115 to make up for the overcharge so far. Then, the bill after that, and for the 11 months following, will be for the flat $115 plus tax.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, I see. So I get a little extra credit on the next one to even things out. That makes sense. That's very good, actually.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. I'm processing the change now... just one moment...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, it's done. I have successfully applied the '12-Month Loyalty Credit' of $10 per month to your account, effective today.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wonderful. Thank you so much for your help with this.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure. For your records, the confirmation number for this change is L-C-8-3-9-2-1. You'll also receive an email from Cymbal Telecom confirming this change within 24 hours.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, L-C-8-3-9-2-1. Got it. I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome, Ms. Taylor.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You've been very helpful, Alex. I was a bit worried when I saw that bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm glad I could clear things up and find a good resolution for you. That's what we're here for.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Well, you did a great job.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. While I have you on the line, is there anything else I can assist with? Any questions about your TV channels, your voicemail, or maybe the speed of your Cymbal Wi-Fi?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, everything else is working fine. The internet is great. It was just the bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Happy to hear it. In that case, thank you for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer and thank you for your call today.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, Alex. Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too, Ms. Taylor. Goodbye.
